name: joltphysics
description: A multi core friendly rigid body physics and collision detection library suitable for games and VR applications

avx.description: Enable AVX (baseline is SSE4.2 on x86, NEON on ARM)

avx2.description: Enable AVX2, AVX, LZCNT, TZCNT, F16C and FMA

avx512.description: Enable AVX512 and the AVX2 feature set

debugrenderer.description: Enable debug renderer in Debug and Release builds

disable-custom-allocator.description: Disable support for a custom memory allocator

object-stream.description: Compile the ObjectStream class and RTTI attribute information

profiler.description: Enable the profiler in Debug and Release builds

floating-point-exceptions.description: Turns on division by zero and invalid floating point exception support

std-vector.description: Use std::vector instead of Jolt's own Array class
